title: Kimmy:
title_short: Kimmy · Transparency Means the Messy Parts Too
headline: Watsi published its own mistake: transparency has to include the bad news, and that is how trust is earned.
story: Watsi's 2026 theme is trust and transparency, and the FAQ videos must be credible to a skeptical first-time visitor. This one is the proof. Kimmy tells how an internal audit found that patients at one partner had started treatment before Watsi approved them, and that Watsi wrote about it publicly.

The order: the hook line, her own words that Watsi wrote about it, how they check, the audit story, what they changed, then here's where something broke, here's what we found, here's what we're changing, and the button: being transparent about the messy parts is part of earning trust. Loops: L1 “What mistake?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the audit story. L2 “What did they do about it?” closes on the three phrases. Hopeful and calm, never a scandal.
do: Open on her face with <q>We published our own mistake.</q> already on screen at 0:00.
Show the real blog post when she says Watsi wrote about it.
Put the three phrases on screen one at a time as she says them.
Name super <q>Kimmy · Watsi</q>, large, lower left, after the hook.
Stay in the clean take C5068. Trim breaths, keep her pace.
dont: Don't open on “So when I think about a Watsi medical partnership”. That is the warm-up.
Don't make this about “how do you know surgeries happened”. That is Mackinnon's V05.
Don't use C5064, C5065 or C5066. They are other videos.
No music under her voice. No stock.
Never name CSC or any partner hospital. Don't invent a title for Kimmy.

She sits in the middle of the grey sofa, black watsi tee, window with the Williamsburg skyline and a palm plant behind her. 9:16 crop centred on her face. Her face is the strongest picture here, so no B-roll.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1: We published our own mistake. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third, Lato Black, white, soft shadow. It goes out at 00:03. Captions start on frame 1.

voice.quote: Transparency can't just mean publishing the good news.

rows.visual: Kimmy, 20260922_C5068.MP4 from 00:52.7. On “written publicly” cut to a new screen recording of Watsi's own post Addressing a scaling issue (blog.watsi.org, 8 Jun 2015): the title, then a slow scroll. This is the post she talks about. Record it clean, 1080 px wide, no cursor, no browser bar. It is her saying the hook in her own words.

voice.quote: And we've actually written publicly about this before.

rows.visual: Back to Kimmy, 20260922_C5068.MP4 from 00:27.4. Cut pauses over 0.7 s to about 0.25 s (for example 00:30.1 to 00:30.9 and 00:43.5 to 00:44.4). Hide each jump cut with a slow 3–5% push-in, never above 110% (the 9:16 crop of a 1920×1080 frame is already upscaled 1.78×). No B-roll was shot for this script: her face carries it.
rows.motion: Name super at 00:07 for 2 s, lower left, above the captions, large: Kimmy · Watsi. No title (we do not have one). Key words one at a time as she says them, top band: We ask questions / we check the records.

voice.quote: We're working with people and systems, and neither is perfect. If we notice something off, say a partner isn't following a reporting process the way they're supposed to, or something isn't lining up in our records, we always take the time to look into it. We ask questions, we check the records, and sometimes we bring in our own team to look at what's happening on the ground.

rows.visual: Kimmy, 20260922_C5068.MP4 from 00:55.7. On “an internal audit found” cut for about 4 s to the same blog post recording, scrolled to the paragraph about the audit. Back to her face on “The patients ultimately received the care they needed”. Stay on her for “broken, and trust too”. Hide each jump cut with a slow 3–5% push-in, never above 110% (the 9:16 crop of a 1920×1080 frame is already upscaled 1.78×).

voice.quote: A few years ago, as Watsi was growing very quickly, an internal audit found that several patients at one of our medical partners had started treatment before they had been formally submitted to Watsi for approval. The patients ultimately received the care they needed and were fully funded, but the process had been broken, and trust too.

rows.visual: Kimmy, 20260922_C5068.MP4 from 01:19.0. Cut the long pauses (01:28.3 to 01:30.2 and 01:33.5 to 01:35.1) to about 0.25 s. Hide each jump cut with a slow 3–5% push-in, never above 110% (the 9:16 crop of a 1920×1080 frame is already upscaled 1.78×). Never name a partner or hospital: she names none.
rows.motion: Top text as she says it, 3 s, top band: <q>We audited the operational processes</q>. Captions on.

voice.quote: We wrote about what happened, explained why it happened. In this case, our partners were scaling very quickly and were dealing with administrative backlogs, and then shared what we were doing to prevent it from happening again. We audited the operational processes across our medical partners and put additional support in place to help them scale with us.

rows.visual: Kimmy, 20260922_C5068.MP4 from 01:51.0. Stay on her face: these three phrases are the heart of the video. Slow push-in across the row.
rows.motion: Three kinetic lines, one at a time as she says each one, top band: <q>Here's where something broke.</q> / <q>Here's what we found.</q> / <q>Here's what we're changing.</q> Each line holds until the next one comes in. Captions stay on.

voice.quote: If you're asking people to trust you with their money and to believe that the system works, you also have to be willing to say, here's where something broke, here's what we found, and here's what we're changing.

rows.visual: Kimmy, 20260922_C5068.MP4 from 02:08.9 to 02:24.2. The words “is actually part of earning that trust” play once. Hold 1 s on her after “trust.”, then cut to the end card.

voice.quote: And if something is genuinely wrong, we have paused partnerships while it gets sorted out or have even closed partnerships. The whole point of this model is trust. And for me, being transparent about the messy parts is actually part of earning that trust.

rows.visual: Clean end card. Light cyan #D3EDFA background. Navy is never a background.
rows.motion: watsi.org, all lowercase, Lato, navy #2E2844. One line. Nothing else.
